title: Onboarding - Model Compatibility Debrief (week of 2027-10-04)
content:
Summary:
Week focused on compatibility triage for two newly onboarded open models (kuma-3b and siren-7b) under quantized paths. Worked through three regression classes: degenerate tokenization with kv cache, embedding drift on mixed-precision, and hallucination increase under 4-bit asymmetric quantization. This doc captures experiments, short-term mitigations, and next-week action items.

Highlights / Wins:
- Reproduced kv-cache mismatch locally (deterministic seed) for kuma-3b when switching from fp16->int8 path; root cause narrowed to rotary embedding scaling inconsistency in the conversion kernel.
- Built quick eval harness that runs truthset-ops v3 against both float and quantized runtimes in CI; baseline vs quantized comparison now automated (green on latency, red on embedding drift for siren-7b).
- Canary rollout plan for siren-7b established: 5% traffic to quantized variant with forced fallback on embedding regression detection.

Experiments run (short notes):
- E1: fp16 -> int8 symmetric quantization (kuma-3b)
  - Config: per-channel, calibration batch = 1k tokens sampled from webtext-like stream
  - Observed: +2.8% average per-token cost reduction; latency stable (-6ms p95); deterministic sample produced token id mismatch at step 74 when kv-reuse enabled.
  - Hypothesis: rotary scaling not applied consistently to cached keys for int8 kernel.

- E2: 4-bit asymmetric (siren-7b) with outlier folding
  - Config: block size 64, outlier threshold 3.5 stddev
  - Observed: embedding L2 drift = 0.12 (vs float baseline 0.03) on classification probe; hallucination metric (QA hallucination rate) +4pp.
  - Quick mitigation: enable per-channel min-max clipping prepack reduces drift to 0.06 but increases decode latency +8ms.

- E3: function-calling / structured output smoke with quantized runtime
  - Found malformed JSON output only when logits rounding occurred near classification boundary (fp16 stable). Root cause is post-softmax precision loss for top-k selection under low-temperature prompts.

Triage items (urgent):
- KV-cache mismatch (kuma-3b int8) [Blocker for Dedicated rollout]
  - Assigned: Marco
  - Immediate step: add assert in conversion path to check rotary scale factors applied to cached keys/values (PR #984).
  - Longer: upstream kernel change to carry scaling metadata through caching layer.

- Embedding drift on siren-7b 4-bit path [Mitigate via rollout policy]
  - Assigned: Lena
  - Immediate step: add offline embedding regression detector to rollout pipeline (compare per-topic centroid L2 with baseline).
  - Short-term policy: route embeddings for classification routes through fp16 fallback when drift > 0.08.

- Function-calling structured output failures [Low severity but flaky for customers]
  - Assigned: Oren
  - Action: add top-k selection test at int-precision threshold into C++ sampling module; add end-to-end test to CI with low-temp function-call prompts.

Metrics snapshot (quick table, updated 2027-10-07):
- Kuma-3b (fp16 baseline) p95 latency: 58ms | int8 p95: 52ms | token-cost delta: -3.0%
- Siren-7b (fp16 baseline) embedding L2 (classification probe): 0.03 | 4-bit: 0.12 | after clipping: 0.06
- Hallucination QA rate (siren-7b): baseline 6.1% | 4-bit 10.1%

Decisions made this week:
- Hold Dedicated rollout for kuma-3b quantized variant until KV-cache asserts pass in integration (target: end of next sprint).
- Enable automatic embedding-fallback policy for any route tagged `classification` for models with quantized onboarding until drift < 0.05 on held-out probes.
- Add 'quantization-smoke' gate to model onboarding checklist: mandatory run of truthset-ops v3 with both generation and embedding probes.

Notes-to-self / open questions:
- Can we reduce calibration batch size while preserving per-channel scale stability? Running a micro-benchmark to test 100/300/1k samples. (Aisha)
- Is asymmetric 4-bit with outlier-folding fundamentally worse for generative fidelity than per-channel symmetric 8-bit for these architectures? Need controlled eval across 10 prompts per category. (Lena)
- Explore lightweight kv-cache checksum in prod logs (privacy-safe summary) so we can detect divergence without retaining tokens. (Marco/Oren)

Next actions (for next week):
- Complete PR #984 (convert-kv-rotary-scale-assert) and get +1 from infra. Run canary integration. (Marco)
- Implement embedding regression detector and add fallback rule to rollout engine. Draft confluence page for detection thresholds. (Lena)
- Add top-k precision test and extend CI matrix to include low-temperature function-calling tests. (Oren)
- Run calibration-sample micro-bench and report findings by Friday. (Aisha)

Meeting notes (standup 2027-10-07):
- Quick sync 10m: Marco: kernel assert green in local; failing in one AWS region due to different CPU instruction ordering (investigating). Lena: embedding detector proto live; need data retention schema. Oren: sampling test added to e2e, flaky in docker alpine image.
- Action items repeated above.

Attachments / artifacts to check:

- Jira: AM-3217 (siren-7b quant onboarding)
- CI run: circleci.com/gh/redwood-inference/serve/345678 (quant-smoke-2027-10-06)
